summary: Phase 1 (Mock OTP auth + Location detection) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (OTP send/verify with valid+invalid+reused request_id, geo/reverse-pin for Bengaluru & Bandra & out-of-service, /auth/me with mobile-JWT, email register/login regression, product count = 164). Frontend: OTP screen renders with +91 prefix and disabled Get-OTP until 10 valid digits; entering 9876543210 + '123456' verifies and redirects to /(tabs) home with home-loc-btn visible. Auth screen shows 'Sign in with mobile OTP' button + 'continue as guest' link (both wired to /otp and /(tabs)). LocationSheet auto-opens on Home first-load after ~0.8s when no location saved; typing '560001' triggers serviceability check and displays 'Bengaluru Central', Confirm & Continue enables and updates pill to 'Bengaluru Central · 560001'. No React hooks-rule errors observed on product detail. Tab switching (Home/Shop/Cart/Profile) works. OTP send/verify is MOCKED — dev_code=123456 returned to client for testing; any 6-digit numeric OTP is accepted (verified).

issues: Send button visually greys out (opacity 0.5) correctly but has no aria-disabled or disabled attribute at DOM level when validMobile true — Playwright reads aria-disabled='true' before valid and null after — behaviour is correct, purely a11y note.

react_native_issues.issue: React warning: 'React does not recognize the defaultMuted prop on a DOM element'. Change defaultMuted to lowercase defaultmuted (or drop it — muted attribute already covers this). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:49

Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated for RN 0.75+ compliance. Reference: repeated across theme.shadow.* usage and (tabs)/index.tsx LinearGradient pointerEvents="box-none"

action_items: Optional a11y polish: on Pressable disabled state in /otp.tsx, also set accessibilityState={{ disabled: true }} so screen readers know send/verify buttons are inactive.
Fix React web warning by removing defaultMuted from the <video> element in HeroVideo (index.tsx) — 'muted' attribute already covers autoplay policy.
Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to boxShadow and inline pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (theme.ts / LinearGradient) — visual only, no functional impact.
No functional bugs found in Phase 1 scope — feature can be marked complete.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1230 lines — approaching maintainability threshold; consider splitting auth (OTP + email), geo, products, orders, subscriptions into separate routers/modules in a future refactor.

OTP verify accepts ANY 6-digit code — this is documented as MOCK, but ensure a real provider integration replaces the '(len==6 and isdigit())' fallback before production. Recommend a feature flag (e.g., OTP_MOCK=true) instead of hard-coded logic.
otp_requests collection has TTL on expires_at (good) and unique index on request_id — solid design.
geo/reverse-pin cutoff of 4 sq-degrees (~200km) is generous; for lat=0,lng=0 it correctly returns null.
Frontend api.ts: apiFetch throws on non-2xx but does not distinguish 401 vs 400 for UX; consider surfacing status code to caller for retries.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests auto-create mobile users +919876500001..+919876500005 via OTP verify (idempotent — synthetic emails).
